media.title: Media Download Tool
media.intro: Media download tool supporting direct URL batch downloads and webpage image/video extraction, with concurrent downloads, file type filtering and ZIP packaging
media.urlHelper: The system will automatically format non-standard URLs, including removing symbols before http/https and adding missing protocols
media.urlPlaceholder: e.g. https://example.com/image.jpg or example.com/video.mp4 or any URL containing http
media.extractHelper: Enter the full webpage address; the system will attempt to extract all images from the page (static images on the current page only)
media.videoExtractHelper: Enter the address of a webpage containing videos; the system will attempt to extract all video resources from the page
media.infoIntro: Media Download: A Webpage Image/Video Extraction and Batch Download Tool
media.problem1: Download media files such as images, videos and audio from webpages.
media.problem2: This tool provides three download modes: direct URL batch download (paste multiple file links for one-click download), webpage image extraction (enter a webpage URL to automatically extract all images from the page), and webpage video extraction (enter a webpage URL to automatically detect video source addresses embedded in the page).
media.problem3: Use it online anytime, anywhere, without installing professional software.
media.formatImage: Image Formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, ICO, BMP — covering all common image formats. The tool automatically detects image MIME types during extraction.
media.formatVideo: Video Formats: MP4, WebM, OGG, M3U8 (HLS streaming) — supports both direct links and streaming addresses. Note: DRM-protected videos cannot be downloaded.
media.formatAudio: Audio Formats: MP3, AAC, OGG, WAV — audio files embedded in webpages can also be extracted.
media.featureOnline: URL Batch Download: Paste multiple file links (one per line) — supports automatic correction of non-standard URL formats, including removing leading symbols and adding missing protocol headers.
media.featurePreview: Real-time Preview: Results are displayed instantly for easy adjustment and confirmation.
media.featureExport: One-click Export: Quickly export processed files or copy results.
media.featureSecurity: Data Security: All data is processed locally and never uploaded to any server.
media.usageUrlInput: Enter URLs: Enter the URLs of the media files in the text box, one per line.
media.usageUrlFormat: URL formatting: The system will automatically format non-standard URLs, including removing symbols before http/https and adding missing protocols.
media.usageUrlFormatSupport: Supported formats: Supports image (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, etc.) and video (MP4, WebM, FLV, etc.) formats.
media.usageExtractUrl: Enter the URL: Enter the webpage address in the input box, e.g. https://example.com/page.html.
media.usageExtractImage: Extract images: Click the "Extract Images" button and the system will attempt to extract all static images from the page.
media.usageSelectImage: Select images: Check or uncheck images to choose which ones to download.
media.usageAddToQueue: Add to queue: Click "Add Selected to Download Queue" to add the selected images to the download list.
media.usageVideoUrl: Enter the URL: Enter the address of a webpage containing videos in the input box.
media.usageExtractVideo: Extract videos: Click the "Extract Videos" button and the system will attempt to extract all video resources from the page.
media.usageSelectVideo: Select videos: Check or uncheck videos to choose which ones to download.
media.usageAddVideoQueue: Add to queue: Click "Add Selected to Download Queue" to add the selected videos to the download list.
media.usageConcurrency: Concurrent downloads: Set the number of files downloaded simultaneously, from 1 to 10, default 3.
media.usageFileType: File type filter: Choose "All Types", "Images Only" or "Videos Only".
media.usageMinSize: Minimum image size: Set the minimum image size for filtering; choose No Limit, 100×100, 200×200 or 500×500.
media.usageStartClick: Click to download: Click the "Start Download" button to begin batch downloading.
media.usageStartProgress: View progress: Download progress is displayed in real time, including total files, completed, failed and skipped counts.
media.usageStartClear: Clear the list: Click the "Clear List" button to remove all download tasks.
media.noteCors: CORS restrictions: Most websites implement CORS policies that restrict JavaScript from accessing their resources from different domains.
media.noteHotlink: Hotlink protection: Many image hosting sites implement anti-hotlinking mechanisms that check the Referer header of requests.
media.noteAccess: Access control: Some servers detect whether requests originate from a real browser environment.
media.noteNetwork: Network restrictions: Some servers may intentionally set connection timeouts or be unstable to block batch downloads.
media.noteHandleUnavailable: Resources that cannot be downloaded: The system will mark them as "link saved" and you can access these resources in your browser using the "Open saved link in a new tab" button.
media.noteHandleManual: Manual download: For resources that cannot be downloaded automatically, right-click the link and choose "Open in new tab", then right-click to save.
media.noteSecurity1: All processing is done entirely in your local browser; no data is uploaded to any server.
media.noteSecurity2: Avoid processing resources containing sensitive information on public devices.
media.noteProcess1: Do not close the browser or refresh the page during processing, otherwise the processing will fail and data may be lost.
media.noteProcess2: Large files may take a long time to process; please be patient.
media.noteFaq1: Download failed: Check your network connection, or try lowering the number of concurrent downloads.
media.noteFaq2: No extraction results: Some websites load images dynamically with JavaScript, which cannot be extracted through static methods.
media.noteFaq3: Corrupted files: The server may return incomplete files; try downloading again.
media.noteFaq4: Browser restrictions: Some browsers may restrict automatic downloads and require manual permission.

media.errInvalidUrlFormat: Please enter a valid URL format

media.errVideosAdded: Successfully added {{count}} videos to the download queue!

media.errNoValidUrls: No valid file addresses found! Please check the input format.
media.errNoMatchingFiles: No files match the criteria! Please check the file type filter settings.
media.errMaxFilesExceeded: Maximum 100 files per batch; automatically limited to the first 100.
media.htmlCorsUnavailable: All CORS proxy services are unavailable
media.htmlImageExtractTip1: Tip: Due to cross-origin restrictions and the instability of public CORS proxy services, images may not be extractable directly from some websites.
media.htmlImageExtractTip3: 1. Use browser developer tools to manually copy image links
media.htmlImageExtractTip4: 2. Install a browser CORS extension (e.g., Chrome's "Allow CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin")
media.htmlImageExtractTip5: 3. Or set up your own CORS proxy server
media.htmlVideoExtractTip1: Tip: Due to cross-origin restrictions, videos may not be extractable directly from some websites.
media.htmlVideoExtractTip3: 1. Use browser developer tools to manually copy video links
media.htmlVideoExtractTip4: 2. For video platforms (e.g., YouTube, Bilibili), copy the share link and use it in the direct URL download

media.htmlVideoPreviewLimit: For performance reasons, only the first {{shown}} videos are shown; {{total}} found in total

media.statusConfirmOpenInNewTab: This file cannot be previewed directly. Open the original link in a new tab?

media.errNetworkError: Network error: Unable to connect to server

media.htmlVideoTimeoutLine2: Please try another website or refresh the page

resource.title: Resource Download Tool
resource.intro: Resource download tool supporting direct URL batch downloads and webpage resource (JS, CSS, fonts, etc.) extraction, with concurrent downloads, type filtering and ZIP packaging
resource.urlHelper: Supports downloading resource files such as JS, CSS, fonts (.ttf/.woff/.woff2) and icons
resource.extractHelper: Enter the webpage address; the system will attempt to extract the JS and CSS resources from the page
resource.infoIntro: Webpage Resource Extraction: A Batch Download Tool for JS/CSS/Fonts and Other Frontend Resources
resource.problemsTitle: 1. Application Scenarios for Webpage Resource Extraction
resource.problem1: Batch download webpage resources and files.
resource.problem2: This tool supports two modes: direct URL download (paste resource links for batch download) and webpage extraction (enter a webpage URL to automatically extract JS/CSS/font resources). Supports concurrent downloads, file type filtering, and ZIP packaging.
resource.problem3: Use it online anytime, anywhere, without installing professional software.
resource.formatFile: File Types: JavaScript (.js), CSS (.css), Web Fonts (.woff/.woff2/.ttf/.eot) — covering the most commonly used resource types in frontend development.
resource.formatResource: Extraction Scope: Parses the href/src attributes of link (CSS/fonts) and script (JS) tags in page HTML — including CDN links and relative paths.
resource.featureOnline: URL Batch Download: Paste multiple resource links for one-click batch download.
resource.featurePreview: Real-time Preview: Results are displayed instantly for easy adjustment and confirmation.
resource.featureExport: One-click Export: Quickly export processed files or copy results.
resource.featureSecurity: Data Security: All data is processed locally and never uploaded to any server.
resource.usageUrlInput: Enter URLs: Enter the URLs of the resource files in the text box, one per line.
resource.usageUrlSupport: Supported formats: Supports webpage static resource files such as JS, CSS, fonts (.ttf/.woff/.woff2) and icons.
resource.usageUrlFormat: URL formatting: The system will automatically format non-standard URLs.
resource.usageExtractUrl: Enter the URL: Enter the webpage address in the input box, e.g. https://example.com/page.html.
resource.usageExtract: Extract resources: Click the "Extract Resources" button and the system will attempt to extract the JS and CSS resources from the page.
resource.usageSelect: Select resources: Check or uncheck resources to choose which ones to download.
resource.usageAddQueue: Add to queue: Click "Add Selected to Download Queue" to add the selected resources to the download list.
resource.usageConcurrency: Concurrent downloads: Set the number of files downloaded simultaneously, from 1 to 10, default 3.
resource.usageFileType: File type filter: Choose "All Types", "JS Files Only", "CSS Files Only" or "Font Files Only".
resource.usagePackZip: Pack as ZIP: When checked, downloaded files will be automatically packaged into a ZIP archive.
resource.usageQuickLink: Click the quick links: Quick download links for common CDN resources are provided at the bottom of the page; click one to add it to the download queue.
resource.usageQuickInclude: Included resources: Includes common frontend libraries such as jQuery, Vue, React and Bootstrap.
resource.usageStartClick: Click to download: Click the "Start Download" button to begin batch downloading.
resource.usageStartProgress: View progress: Download progress is displayed in real time, including total files, completed, failed and skipped counts.
resource.usageStartClear: Clear the list: Click the "Clear List" button to remove all download tasks.
resource.usageStartDirect: Direct download: For resources that cannot be downloaded automatically, click the "Direct Download" button to download them directly in your browser.
resource.noteCors: CORS restrictions: Most websites implement CORS policies that restrict JavaScript from accessing their resources from different domains.
resource.noteHotlink: Hotlink protection: Many resource hosting sites implement anti-hotlinking mechanisms that check the origin of requests.
resource.noteAccess: Access control: Some servers detect whether requests originate from a real browser environment.
resource.noteHandleUnavailable: Resources that cannot be downloaded: For resources that cannot be downloaded automatically, you can copy the link and access it directly in your browser to download.
resource.noteHandleDirect: Direct download: Click the "Direct Download" button to open the resource link directly in your browser.
resource.noteHandlePack: Packaged download: With the "Pack as ZIP" option checked, all successfully downloaded files will be automatically packaged into a ZIP archive.
resource.noteSecurity1: All processing is done entirely in your local browser; no data is uploaded to any server.
resource.noteSecurity2: Avoid processing resources containing sensitive information on public devices.
resource.noteProcess1: Do not close the browser or refresh the page during processing, otherwise the processing will fail and data may be lost.
resource.noteProcess2: Large files may take a long time to process; please be patient.
resource.noteFaq1: Download failed: Check your network connection, or try lowering the number of concurrent downloads.
resource.noteFaq2: No extraction results: Some websites load resources dynamically with JavaScript, which cannot be extracted through static methods.
resource.noteFaq3: Corrupted files: The server may return incomplete files; try downloading again.
resource.noteFaq4: Browser restrictions: Some browsers may restrict automatic downloads and require manual permission.
resource.noteFaq5: Packaging failed: Too many or too large files may cause packaging to fail; try downloading in batches.
